title: NSGo game plugin manifest (version 1)
description: Manifest describes a Go plugin module. Plugin authors write it as YAML in [FileName] (plugin.yaml) at the root of the plugin's Go module; [Parse] and [ParseFS] read it and [Encode] writes it.

manifestVersion.description: ManifestVersion is the schema version of plugin.yaml. A file must state [ManifestVersion] (1); a manifest built in code may leave it 0, and [Encode] writes [ManifestVersion].

name.description: Name uniquely identifies the plugin: 1 to 64 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

module.description: Module is the Go module path of the plugin, which must equal the module line of its go.mod.

description.description: Description summarizes what the plugin provides on a single line.

license.description: License is the plugin's license identifier, such as "MIT" or "Apache-2.0".

authors.description: Authors names the people or organizations who maintain the plugin.

repository.description: Repository is the HTTP or HTTPS URL of the plugin's source repository.

engine.description: Engine is a semantic version constraint on github.com/nsgo-dev/game, such as ">=0.4.0 <0.5.0".

api.description: API is the plugin API version (gameplugin.APIVersion) the plugin targets; it must be a positive integer.

platforms.description: Platforms lists the target platforms the plugin supports: either ["all"] or a subset of macos, windows, linux, ios, android and web. When omitted, all platforms are supported.

entries.description: Entries names the Go packages inside Module that provide the plugin's runtime, editor and CLI integrations.

requires.description: Requires maps Go module paths of plugins this plugin depends on to semantic version constraints.

conflicts.description: Conflicts lists Go module paths of plugins that cannot be installed alongside this plugin.

contributes.description: Contributes summarizes the components, editor extensions and agent tools the plugin registers, for indexing and comparison by game plugin check.

CLIEntry.description: CLIEntry names one command package a plugin contributes to the game CLI.

name.description: Name is the subcommand name invoked as "game <name>": 1 to 64 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

package.description: Package is the Go import path of the main package implementing the command, inside the plugin's module.

Contributes.description: Contributes indexes the components, editor extensions and agent tools a plugin registers. Tools such as game plugin check compare it against the plugin's code.

components.description: Components lists the names of scene components the plugin registers.

editor.description: Editor lists the panels, tools and commands the plugin adds to the scene editor.

agentTools.description: AgentTools lists the MCP agent tool names the plugin exposes, such as "plugin.healthkit.heal_all".

EditorContributes.description: EditorContributes lists the editor extension IDs a plugin registers.

panels.description: Panels lists the IDs of editor panels the plugin adds.

tools.description: Tools lists the IDs of viewport tools the plugin adds.

commands.description: Commands lists the IDs of editor commands the plugin adds.

Entries.description: Entries names the Go packages inside a plugin's module that integrate with the game runtime, the scene editor and the game CLI. At least one of Runtime, Editor or CLI must be set.

runtime.description: Runtime is the import path of the Go package that provides the plugin's runtime entry (func Plugin() gameplugin.Plugin).

editor.description: Editor is the import path of the Go package that provides the plugin's editor entry (func Plugin() editor.Plugin).

cli.description: CLI lists command packages that extend the game CLI via go.mod tool directives.
